elevate.move: Bring one cool-graded shoot under the probe: 3-4 approved library frames (sun-peeled hood, gauge on panel, booth light, finished panel in sun), each carrying the crosshair dot and an LCD reading tag on its corner; the first as the promised 4:3 band in the hero's right column with the readout overlapping its top edge, and a real booth frame behind the 'Matched in the booth' swatches.

Put trade and El Paso into the display h1 (e.g. 'Sun-peeled paint in El Paso? Tap your paint.'), cut the hero to ~820px so the probe-night story band peeks 80px, and let the hero readout count up to the sorter's value on load so shop, city, instrument and next band read in one glance.
